name: profile-skills
description: Measured performance engineering for agentic development: profile Python, JavaScript/TypeScript (Node and Bun), browser and Bash code to find real hotspots; decide 'faster or not' with one interleaved, paired, confidence-interval rule; optimize in a recursive loop that keeps a change only if it is significant and the tests stay green; and gate regressions in CI on the R1-R5 rigor profiles shared with test-skills.
